title: The Rainbow Glitter Kids' New Year's Eve Countdown
description: A kids' New Year's Eve countdown from Amazon: a pin the hour hand countdown clock game, glitter top hats, light-up 2027 glasses, no-mess streamer poppers, a 100 pack of glow sticks and mini New Year coloring books.
intro: Real talk: my kids have never once made it to midnight. Last year one of them was asleep under the coffee table by 9:40 holding a cracker. So this year we're doing a kids' countdown that actually holds their attention. Glitter top hats, light-up 2027 glasses, glow sticks for days, streamer poppers that don't leave confetti in the couch till March, and a pin-the-hour-hand clock game. Whoever's still awake gets the last popper. That's the rule.

sections.heading: The countdown game
paragraphs: A black and gold Pin the New Year's Eve clock poster (29 x 19 in) with gold hour hands and a blindfold. Tape it to a cabinet, spin the kids, and let them fight about who got closest to midnight.

sections.heading: The sparkly bits
paragraphs: Bright glitter plastic top hats in a 12 pack of mixed colors, LED 2027 glasses that flash in pink, green, blue and red, and a 100 pack of 8 inch glow sticks with connectors so everybody gets a bracelet, a necklace and a crown.

sections.heading: The no-mess finale
paragraphs: Hand-throw streamer poppers with colorful paper streamers and zero confetti, plus a 24 pack of mini New Year coloring books for the quiet stretch around 10 pm when everyone's fading.
